correctness.rationale: The exact sublattice multiplicity gives a convergent positive one-dimensional series and a normalized negative-binomial conditional law. Analytic endpoint and normalization arguments are reconstructed in RESULT.md; the standalone checker passes eight exact finite-cap comparisons and four high-temperature diagnostic parameter cases.
